# Scalar API Reference

To update, select an explicit published version, verify registry integrity, replace the standalone.js file and license, update the versioned file name in `scripts/build-docs.py` and `docs/site/rest.html`, update this record, then run checks and test rendering/request execution in the browser. No npm runtime is required.
